package deal

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/action-state-group/capsule-cli/cli"
	"github.com/action-state-group/checkpointed-local-log/go/checkpoint"
	"github.com/action-state-group/checkpointed-local-log/go/cll"
	"github.com/action-state-group/checkpointed-local-log/go/witness"
	"github.com/fxamacker/cbor/v2"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/veraison/go-cose"
)

// Writes capsule-viewer#214's deal witness fixtures (see README.md).
func mintReceiptAt(t *testing.T, entry []byte, key ed25519.PrivateKey, iat int64) []byte {
	proof, err := cbor.Marshal([]any{int64(1), int64(0), [][]byte{}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	leaf := sha256.Sum256(append([]byte{0}, entry...))
	message := cose.NewSign1Message()
	message.Headers.Protected.SetAlgorithm(cose.AlgorithmEdDSA)
	message.Headers.Protected[int64(395)] = int64(1)
	message.Headers.Protected[int64(15)] = map[any]any{int64(6): iat}
	message.Headers.Unprotected[int64(396)] = map[any]any{int64(-1): []any{proof}}
	message.Payload = leaf[:]
	signer, err := cose.NewSigner(cose.AlgorithmEdDSA, key)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, message.Sign(rand.Reader, nil, signer))
	message.Payload = nil
	encoded, err := message.MarshalCBOR()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return encoded
}

func deliverAt(t *testing.T, p cli.Profile, size uint64, signer ed25519.PrivateKey, iat int64) {
	target, err := openOwnedTarget(t.Context(), p, cli.UseCLL, &dealStoreLock{held: true})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	service, err := cli.ServiceID(p)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	state, err := target.Log.GetWitness(t.Context(), service, size)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	record, err := checkpoint.ParseRecord(state.Checkpoint)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	entry, err := record.EntryHash()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	next := state
	next.Receipt = &cll.WitnessReceiptState{Bytes: mintReceiptAt(t, entry, signer, iat), EntryHash: hex.EncodeToString(entry), EntryHashScheme: witness.EntryHashSchemeCheckpointDigest, LeafIndex: ptr(int64(0)), TreeSize: ptr(int64(1))}
	require.NoError(t, target.Log.CommitWitness(t.Context(), state.Attempts, next))
	require.NoError(t, target.Close())
	s, err := openDealSession(t.Context(), p)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	c, cp, err := s.cadenceOf(t.Context())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, s.witnessNativeTicks(t.Context(), c, cp))
	require.NoError(t, s.close())
}

func TestZZViewer214Fixtures(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("VIEWER214_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	public, key, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	endpoint, _ := countingWitness(t)
	p := cadenceFixture(t, endpoint, public, "1h", "0s", 0)
	now := clockAt(t, time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	dealID := retailDeal(t)
	directory := writeDirectory(t, rawKeyRow(endpoint, public))
	verdicts := map[string]any{}
	report := func(name string) {
		path := filepath.Join(out, name+".json")
		dealRun(t, "report", "--deal", dealID, "--bundle", path, "--html", filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), name+".html"))
		result, _ := verifyWithDirectory(t, path, directory)
		verdicts[name] = result["witnesses"]
	}
	require.Equal(t, "ticked", dealRun(t, "tick")["state"])
	deliverAt(t, p, cadenceSize(t, p), key, time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 9, 0, 5, 0, time.UTC).Unix())
	report("cadence-all")
	*now = now.Add(10 * time.Minute)
	dealRun(t, "note", "--deal", dealID, "--kind", "message", "--input", writeJSON(t, `{"from":"counterparty","text":"Your order has shipped."}`))
	report("cadence-part")
	spki, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(public)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	meta, _ := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"witness_spki_hex": hex.EncodeToString(spki), "witness_endpoint": endpoint, "go_witnesses": verdicts}, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "meta.json"), meta, 0o600))
}
